children: has sent a force majeure notice to the developer of a massive data center project in New Mexico to protect itself from potential payments if the facility is delayed, Bloomberg reported, citing people familiar with the matter.
The data center, known as Project Jupiter, is being developed by Stack Infrastructure, a portfolio company of Blue Owl Capital
. Oracle is the main tenant of the facility.
Oracle shares fell about 4% in premarket trading after the report, while Blue Owl shares fell 4% and Bloom Energy
shares fell 5%. The facility is expected to use Bloom Energy fuel cells. SoftBank (SFTBY) shares shed 6% value.

Oracle is seeking to defer payments if the project is delayed and does not come online as planned in 2028, according to Bloomberg. It was not immediately clear whether the notice would release Oracle from its existing financial obligations.
Project Jupiter is designed to have 2.45 gigawatts of capacity and is part of the broader Stargate artificial intelligence infrastructure effort involving Oracle, OpenAI
, and SoftBank. About 20 banks provided an $18B loan to help finance the data center campus.

title: Oracle sends force majeure notice over New Mexico data center: report
